blocks.text: While many fans would agree that Regine Velasquez remains timeless, the singer opened up about learning to work with a singing voice that has changed as she goes through menopause. During the press conference for her upcoming “Finale” concert last Friday, Sept. 25, in Quezon City, the Asia’s Songbird revealed that she previously went to Singapore to have her voice checked, and despite having no problems detected in her vocal cords, she experienced what she described as a “menopause voice.” “I went through something like… it’s called the menopause voice.
